requirements.summary: Add null check and error handling for root element lookup in main.tsx
acceptanceCriteria: main.tsx uses document.getElementById('root') to get the root element
A null check is present before calling createRoot
If root element is missing, console.error logs 'Root element #root not found'
If root element is missing, a visible error message appears in document.body

file_operations.description: Add a null check after document.getElementById('root'). If the root element is null, log 'Root element #root not found' to console.error and display a visible error message in document.body with red background and white text indicating the root element is missing.

requirements.summary: Wrap React initialization in try-catch block with comprehensive error handling
acceptanceCriteria: try-catch block wraps createRoot and render calls
Caught errors are logged to console.error with stack traces
Caught errors display visible error message in document.body with red background
Error message includes the error name and message

file_operations.description: Wrap the ReactDOM.createRoot and root.render calls in a try-catch block. In the catch block, log the error with full stack trace to console.error and create a visible error message element appended to document.body with red background, white text, padding, and displaying the error name and message.

requirements.summary: Add diagnostic console.log statements at strategic execution points
acceptanceCriteria: console.log at the beginning of main.tsx logs 'main.tsx: Script execution started'
console.log after imports logs 'main.tsx: Imports completed'
console.log before createRoot logs 'main.tsx: Mounting React app'
All three console logs appear in browser console during app initialization

file_operations.description: Add console.log('main.tsx: Script execution started') at the very beginning of the file (first line after imports). Add console.log('main.tsx: Imports completed') immediately after all import statements. Add console.log('main.tsx: Mounting React app') immediately before the createRoot call.

requirements.summary: Verify and add defensive error handling for import resolution failures
acceptanceCriteria: All imports in main.tsx resolve without errors
If any import fails, a try-catch block catches it and logs the specific module that failed
Browser console shows clear error messages if imports fail

file_operations.description: Verify all import statements (React, ReactDOM, App, QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider) have valid module paths. If any imports are suspected to fail, wrap critical dynamic imports in try-catch blocks that log the specific failed module name to console.error with a descriptive message.

requirements.summary: Add defensive error handling to InternetIdentityProvider and AuthClient initialization
acceptanceCriteria: AuthClient initialization is wrapped in try-catch
Errors during authentication setup are logged to console.error
Application continues to render with unauthenticated state if authentication setup fails
No uncaught exceptions are thrown from useInternetIdentity hook

file_operations.description: Wrap AuthClient.create() and all async authentication calls in try-catch blocks. Log errors to console.error with descriptive messages. Ensure the hook provides a fallback unauthenticated state (isAuthenticated: false, identity: null) if authentication setup fails, allowing the app to continue rendering without throwing uncaught errors.

acceptanceCriteria: App component has default export
Simplified App component renders successfully
Browser displays 'App component loaded' text when simplified
No JavaScript errors appear in console when rendering simplified App

Verify that App component has a default export. Temporarily add a comment block containing a simplified fallback version: 'export default function App() { return

requirements.summary: Enhance ErrorBoundary with comprehensive logging in componentDidCatch
acceptanceCriteria: ErrorBoundary wraps <App /> in main.tsx
componentDidCatch method logs error.message to console.error
componentDidCatch method logs error.stack to console.error
componentDidCatch method logs errorInfo.componentStack to console.error
ErrorBoundary fallback UI is visible when errors are caught

file_operations.description: Enhance componentDidCatch method to log error.message, error.stack, and errorInfo.componentStack to console.error with clear labels. Ensure the fallback UI displays the error details prominently. Verify the component exports correctly and can catch errors from child components.

Verify that ErrorBoundary component wraps the <App /> component in the render call. Ensure the import path is correct and ErrorBoundary is positioned to catch all rendering errors from App and its children.

requirements.summary: Add resource loading verification and error handling for failed bundle loads
acceptanceCriteria: main.tsx loads with 200 status code
All JavaScript bundles load without 404 errors
No CORS errors in browser console
All static assets required by the app load successfully

file_operations.description: Add error event listener to the script tag loading main.tsx to catch and log script loading failures. Add a global onerror handler in a script tag before the main.tsx import that logs resource loading failures with URL and error details to console.error and displays a visible error message if critical resources fail to load.

requirements.summary: Add defensive null checks and error handling to BurnoutMonitoring components and hooks
acceptanceCriteria: useBurnoutMonitor hook returns valid burnout index before rendering warnings
useBlockingLogic hook returns valid isBlocked state
All child components check for undefined/null values before rendering
No 'Cannot read property of undefined' errors in console

file_operations.description: Add defensive checks to ensure all returned values have safe defaults. Initialize burnoutIndex to 0 and breakdown to { timeBased: 0, switchingBased: 0 } if calculations fail. Wrap complex calculations in try-catch blocks that log errors and return safe default values.

Add defensive initialization for isBlocked state (default to false). Ensure dismissCount and blockStartTime have safe default values. Add try-catch around localStorage operations with fallback to in-memory state if localStorage fails.

Add null/undefined checks before rendering BurnoutWarning, GreyscaleOverlay, and BlockScreen components. Verify that useBurnoutMonitor and useBlockingLogic hooks return defined values before passing them as props. Add conditional rendering: only render BurnoutMonitoring child components if hook data is valid.

Add prop validation at the component entry. Check that burnoutIndex and breakdown props are defined and are valid numbers before rendering. Provide fallback UI or return null if required props are missing.
Add validation for burnoutIndex prop. Ensure numeric calculations handle NaN and Infinity cases. Clamp intensity values to safe ranges (0-1) to prevent invalid CSS values.

Add validation for all props and hook return values used in rendering. Ensure timer and switching frequency data are defined before displaying. Add error boundaries or try-catch around rendering logic that could fail due to undefined state.
